name: Protocol.hex
desc: You're a virus loose inside a computer system: slide along the glowing pathways of the circuit board, infect every node — each one turns pink and becomes yours — and keep away from the green antivirus programs that patrol the traces and chase you down. Infection energy lets you corrupt the system itself: rot a wall into a new pathway to break into a sealed vault, cut a shortcut or escape a hunter. Rotted cells are invisible to the firewall and the scanner, and security escalates sector by sector. An original Arcade Phantasm game; pure HTML5, no dependencies.
controls: Arrows/WASD move, Space rots the wall ahead, Shift speed burst, C plant a trap, Q cloak, F split off a copy, P pause, M mute
creator: CursedPrograms
